description: This class processes input buffers by appending characters, detecting complete lines terminated by CRLF, and notifying a listener with each full response line after unpacking via a decoder.

classes.name: ResponseBuffer
classes.description: A Java class that accumulates incoming strings, detects complete response lines separated by CRLF, and notifies a listener with each line after processing.

methods.name: ResponseBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a specified ResponseListener.

methods.description: Appends input string, detects complete lines separated by CRLF, and calls listener.onResponse() with unpacked lines.

methods.name: hasCRLF
methods.description: Static utility method to check if the StringBuffer contains CR or LF characters.
